newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH NOV MOTOR PETROLEUM SALES FALL 1.4 PCT.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH NOV MOTOR PETROLEUM SALES FALL 1.4 PCT.

text.p: Sales in Finland of motor petroleum fell 1.4 percent year-on-year to 0.14 million tonnes in November, the Finnish Petroleum Association said in a monthly report received on Thursday.
Motor petroleum sales in January-November fell two percent on the year-ago period, the association said.
Total Finnish oil products consumption fell 5.1 percent in November, while consumption for the 11-month period to end-November rose 3.2 percent, it said.
Sales of diesel oil rose 2.5 percent year-on-year in November and 2.8 percent since the start of the year, it said.
Finnish diesel oil sales usually closely track GDP, which is forecast to increase about 2.5 percent this year.
November sales of domestic heating oil fell 17.9 percent year-on-year, largely due to the warmer weather this November than last, the association said.
